marta: quick sync — drafting internal RN for v0.9.4. target internal announce 2024-05-02 09:30 PT. need ops to pin canary alias and confirm rollback criteria.

leo: can pin. propose alias v0.9.4-canary-20240502 pinned to canary pool until 20:00 PT, auto-promote disabled.

sam: TL;DR for #product: "v0.9.4: routing + batching improvements to reduce tail latency. No customer action needed."

marta: perfect. rollback criteria to include: sustained p95 > 3x baseline for 10m OR error_rate > 3% for 5m. put in RN.

leo: ops on-call cover: leo 09:00-12:00, tina 12:00-16:00. i'll schedule the pin after you publish the RN.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued: /deploy canary v0.9.4-canary-20240502 -> staging at 09:45 PT. ops-ack required.

sam: adding runbook snippet and exact commands to RN. snippet: ```
/deploy canary v0.9.4-canary-20240502 -> staging
/open https://dash.redwood/releases/v0.9.4
/rollback canary v0.9.4-canary-20240502
```

ops-bot: [deploybot] ack from ops: leo, tina. Alias pinned when RN published.

marta: i'll post the internal announce in #product at 08:30 PT for quick review. if no objections by 09:15 PT we proceed with the schedule.

leo: no objections from ops. :thumbsup:

sam: good to go from eng-runtime. :rocket:

marta: thanks — publishing RN in 3...2...1 :tada:
